title: 深度扰动预测尚未稳定超过简单基线
content: 在多种 Perturb-seq 数据集与评测协议下，深度生成模型和单细胞基础模型的扰动响应预测并不稳定优于 train mean、加性/线性等简单基线；部分评测中简单基线反而更好。

history.rationale: 多篇独立基准指向同一结论；作为初始命题，后续可用新论文继续补证据或限定条件。

evidence.quote: As our deliberately simple baselines are incapable of representing realistic biological complexity, yet were not outperformed by the foundation models, we conclude that the latter’s goal of providing a generalizable representation of cellular states and predicting the outcome of not-yet-performed experiments is still elusive.
Surprisingly, we found that foundation models generally underperformed compared to a simple baseline model that uses the mean of the training samples.

Results: Here, we present a simple baseline method that outperforms both state of the art (SOTA) in DL and other proposed simpler neural architectures, setting a necessary benchmark to evaluate in the field of post-perturbation prediction.

Recent studies have provided initial benchmarks comparing foundation models, other deep learning architectures, and simple baselines for perturbation effect prediction and reported that complex models do not consistently outperform the simpler alternatives (22–26).

title: 评测协议与指标会改变模型排名
content: 数据集切分（seen/unseen、跨细胞类型）、指标（RMSE 与 PearsonΔ/rank）和预处理差异会显著改变模型排名；跨论文只比单一指标不足以下结论。

after.title: 评测协议与指标会改变模型排名
after.content: 数据集切分（seen/unseen、跨细胞类型）、指标（RMSE 与 PearsonΔ/rank）和预处理差异会显著改变模型排名；跨论文只比单一指标不足以下结论。

history.rationale: 多个基准各自覆盖不同任务/指标，且明确批评指标不一致；需要统一协议才能比较。

evidence.quote: Here, we present a comprehensive benchmark of 27 methods for single-cell perturbation response prediction, evaluated across 29 datasets using 6 complementary performance metrics.

Recent studies have provided initial benchmarks comparing foundation models, other deep learning architectures, and simple baselines for perturbation effect prediction and reported that complex models do not consistently outperform the simpler alternatives (22–26).
Moreover, inconsistent use of performance metrics complicates overarching evaluations.
Through extensive evaluation of both published and baseline models across diverse datasets, we highlight the limitations of widely used models, such as mode collapse.

title: 基础模型在扰动预测上常不如训练集均值
content: scGPT、scFoundation 等基础模型在多个 Perturb-seq 数据集上 fine-tune 后，仍经常低于 train mean；预训练表征的优势没有稳定转化为扰动预测增益。

after.title: 基础模型在扰动预测上常不如训练集均值
after.content: scGPT、scFoundation 等基础模型在多个 Perturb-seq 数据集上 fine-tune 后，仍经常低于 train mean；预训练表征的优势没有稳定转化为扰动预测增益。

history.rationale: 两篇独立评测直接比较基础模型与均值基线，结论方向一致。

evidence.quote: Surprisingly, we found that foundation models generally underperformed compared to a simple baseline model that uses the mean of the training samples.

As our deliberately simple baselines are incapable of representing realistic biological complexity, yet were not outperformed by the foundation models, we conclude that the latter’s goal of providing a generalizable representation of cellular states and predicting the outcome of not-yet-performed experiments is still elusive.

title: 系统性变异会抬高扰动预测分数
content: 常用单细胞扰动数据存在不同程度的系统性变异；以 control 为参考的 PearsonΔ 类指标会随系统性变异升高，导致模型性能虚高。改用去参考/扰动特异性评测后分数显著下降。

title: 组合扰动（尤其协同效应）预测仍很弱
content: 现有模型在组合扰动上多预测 buffering/加性效应，很少正确预测协同效应；no-change/加性基线往往不差，组合扰动是比单基因更难的泛化任务。
